# The RKE2, k3s and Talos releases a cluster may run. An RKE2 or k3s release has the SHA-256 of
# its checksum file and of its install script, which its nodes check before installing anything.
# A Talos release has the digests of Sidero's imager, installer base and extensions image and of
# the QEMU guest agent the extensions image names, which make verify-talos-pins checks by their
# content and Sidero's signature. `make release-pins` adds the releases published since. A pin
# never changes. The newest release of each, which Renovate raises, has to be pinned.
# renovate: datasource=github-releases depName=rancher/rke2
# rke2 = v1.37.2+rke2r1
# renovate: datasource=github-releases depName=k3s-io/k3s
# k3s = v1.37.2+k3s1
# renovate: datasource=github-releases depName=siderolabs/talos
# talos = v1.14.6
